# sailpoint_governance_group (Data Source)

Data source for SailPoint Governance Group. Look up a governance group by `id` or by `filters` (ISC filter expression). Exactly one of `id` or `filters` must be provided.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a governance group by ID
data "sailpoint_governance_group" "by_id" {
  id = "REPLACE_WITH_GOVERNANCE_GROUP_ID"
}

# Look up a governance group by name using an ISC filter expression
data "sailpoint_governance_group" "by_name" {
  filters = "name eq \"Access Approvers\""
}

# Use the resolved ID in an approval scheme
# (example usage — the approval_schemes attribute will be added to sailpoint_role
# in a future enhancement)
output "approvers_group_id" {
  value = data.sailpoint_governance_group.by_name.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (String) ISC filter expression to look up the group (e.g. `name eq "example-group"`). Mutually exclusive with `id`.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the governance group. Mutually exclusive with `filters`.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `member_count` (Number)
- `members` (Attributes Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))
- `modified` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `owner` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner))
